_comment: Advertising campaigns. demand multiplies how strongly a shop pulls people in; reach is the share of residents who hear about it each day (and start out thinking well of it); loyalty and priceCut change how customers behave while it runs. scope "company" campaigns cover every shop.

flyers.name: Flyers
flyers.description: Leaflets through doors nearby. Cheap, brief, and it works.

poster.name: Bus Stop Posters
poster.description: Posters around the neighbourhood for a week.

coupons.name: Discount Coupons
coupons.description: Coupon holders pay 10% less. Brings in bargain hunters and wins some of them for good; you earn less on each sale while it runs.

social.name: Social Media Push
social.description: Reaches students, tourists and impulse buyers far better than paper does. Your review rating matters more while it runs.

loyalty.name: Loyalty Card
loyalty.description: Stamp cards. Customers become regulars sooner and stay loyal against cheaper rivals.

radio.name: Radio Advert
radio.description: Every shop you own, heard all over the city.

billboard.name: Billboard
billboard.description: Two weeks on the main road. Slow, steady, city-wide.

tv.name: TV Campaign
tv.description: The whole city sees it. Expensive, and nothing else comes close.
